lines.text: The Book of Moses was read aloud, and the people excluded all of foreign descent from Israel.
Eliashib the priest prepared a large room for Tobiah, and Nehemiah threw out Tobiah's goods and ordered the rooms purified.
The Levites and singers had gone back to their flocks, so Nehemiah rebuked the officials and stationed them at posts.
Nehemiah rebuked the nobles of Judah for profaning the Sabbath, and he ordered the gates shut until after the Sabbath.
Nehemiah rebuked Jews who married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab, and pointed to the sin of King Saul.
